title: Insight into novel ErMI (M = S, Se) chalcohalide materials for next-generation energy applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34808-34820
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05496F, Paper

Mohannad Al-Hmoud, Banat Gul, Muhammad Salman Khan, Mahmoud AlGharram, Siti Maisarah Aziz, Tariq Al Zoubi, Ashour M. Ahmed
ErSI and ErSeI are indirect magnetic semiconductors with strong exchange splitting. Mechanical investigation demonstrates that both materials are ductile and anisotropic. Both ErSI and ErSeI are attractive thermoelectric multifunctional materials.
